renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Senses dropped, one sitting done — the highest stands face to face with him. Unbroken in the I-self, gathered by his own effort — may he wake and stand in himself till he shines as the greatest lord. His turning whole, all dropped, the prize won — indeed he casts off his sheath.

His method is the word and the taste, unbroken in self-awareness — he is fit to teach and wake pupils rightly. From wanting nothing, self-waking, dropping hope and pride, cutting the road of real-and-unreal — no new body. Inner sense at peace, fancies thin, delighting in his own form, drunk on tasting himself — he reaches freedom, done.

So for the goal I have told the stainless, mind-bright, true mother of freedom: self-waking. This teaching fills even the unfilled and clears doubt — what would chanting scholars do with it? Whole-blessing maker, wildfire to deeds, shower of your own station, free of notions, temple of joy — I bow to the lovely lord taught from the guru's mouth.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: Senses dropped, one good sit — the Highest pulls up face to face. Unbroken in the I-self, self-made — wake up, stand in yourself, till you glow like the top lord. Turning whole, all dropped, prize bagged — sheath officially dropped.

Method: word plus taste, unbroken self-awareness — cleared to teach, waking pupils right. Zero craving, self-woke, hope and pride binned, real-unreal road severed — no respawn. Inner sense chill, fancies thin, vibing in his own form, drunk on self-taste — freedom unlocked, quest complete.

So for the goal — told: stainless, mind-lit, true, freedom's mother. Self-waking, by me. This teaching maxes even zero-progress accounts and wipes doubt — what are the book-chanters going to do? All-blessing plug, wildfire to the deed-field, own-form shower, notion-free, joy temple — bowing to the fine lord straight from the guru's mouth.
